newsitem.title: USA: Boston Tech stake cut by Carso group.
newsitem.headline: Boston Tech stake cut by Carso group.

text.p: Orient Star Holdings and its parent, Carso Global Telecom S.A. de C.V., said Monday they reduced their stake in Boston Technology Inc to 4.11 percent or 1,042,700 common shares.
In a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission, the companies said they sold 487,500 shares of Boston Technology between December 2 and 13 at prices ranging from $18.75 to $22.9137 a share.

The Mexico-based companies said they previously held a 6.04 percent stake or 1,530,200 common shares in the Wakefield, Mass.,-based computer systems and software company. They said they hold the stake for investment.
